import workcell

def call(*a):
    r = workcell.call(*a)
    if not r.ok:

def in_band(g):
    return lo <= g <= hi

# Approach from below. Fine only when a 3.0 g lump cannot exceed hi (gap > 3.15).
# Micro when gap > 0.85 can absorb 0.8 lump. Below that, single micro and hope.
for step in range(40):
    gap = target - g
    if in_band(g) and gap <= 0.10:
        print("BAND", g)
        break
    if g > hi:
        print("OVERSHOOT", g, "net", g-tare)
        # one corrective remove if we still have steps
        r = call("robot", "remove")
        g = gross()
        print(f"corrective remove: {r.text} g={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} gap={target-g:.2f}")
        continue
    if gap > 3.15:
        txt = call("robot", "dose", "fine").text
        g = gross()
        print(f"fine: {txt} g={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} gap={target-g:.2f}")
    elif gap > 0.90:
        # micro relatively safe
        txt = call("robot", "dose", "micro").text
        g = gross()
        print(f"micro: {txt} g={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} gap={target-g:.2f}")

        txt = call("robot", "dose", "micro").text
        g = gross()
        print(f"micro-close: {txt} g={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} gap={target-g:.2f}")
    else:
        print("stop gap", gap)
        break

print(f"DONE g={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f}")
if lo <= g <= hi:
    c = call("checkweigher", "check")
    print(c.text)
else:
